description: IDH dirty-reset guard wiring (ticket 0809, reviewed by two third-party seats 2026-09-28). The same canonical script as the Claude Code PreToolUse wiring in the adapter plugin (claude-code/hooks/hooks.json — the single Claude hook source since 0887): Codex's PreToolUse payload carries tool_input.command and its block contract accepts exit 2 with the reason on stderr, so the guard runs unchanged. The installed hook launcher resolves the checkout from its own real location. Scope: the PreToolUse entry wires the ONE dirty-reset guard; it is not a general Git-mutation boundary. A SessionStart entry also runs scripts/on-start-context.sh, whose stdout reaches the model as context (measured on Codex 0.163.0). Install: run <checkout>/bin/idh install to merge this hook into ~/.codex/hooks.json, verify the guard script exists and answers exit 2 on a fixture (conception/adapter-operations.md), then review and trust it once via /hooks (headless one-offs: --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust). Codex hook trust authenticates the hook definition, not the script it invokes; the script's integrity is the harness checkout's business. Skill case notes (ticket 1404): UserPromptSubmit (typed $skill) and PostToolUse on Bash (a shell read of skills/<name>/SKILL.md) run scripts/skill-case-notes.sh; its additionalContext reaches the model on both events (probe, Codex 0.166.0), plain stdout does so on SessionStart only. Each hook entry is trusted separately by key and hash. Conditional rules (ticket 1424): a second PostToolUse block on ^Bash$ runs scripts/conditional_rules.py, which injects the body of each rules/ file whose paths: globs match a file the shell command names (or a patch header), once per session and rule, as Claude Code does natively. Appended as block 1 so the trusted post_tool_use:0:0 entry keeps its key and hash; inert until trusted via /hooks.

hooks.command: [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" ] || { echo "IDH: hook launcher missing; run <checkout>/bin/idh install from a plain terminal" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" on-start-context.sh

[ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" ] || { echo "IDH: hook launcher missing; run <checkout>/bin/idh install from a plain terminal" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$HOME/.local/bin/idh-hook" guard-destructive-bash.sh
